metadata.title: CoreWeave shares fall on borrowing cost concerns, and other early market movers - MarketWatch

content.text:
Oct. 15, 5:25am ET
CoreWeave shares fall on borrowing cost concerns, and other early market movers
Here are some of stocks making notable moves in Thursday's premarket action:
CoreWeave's stock declined almost 6% on fears over the cloud-computing company's financial health as its bond yields surpassed 15%.
The prices of fellow neocloud names also decreased as concerns spread across the rest of the sector, with Nebius Group and Core Scientific down nearly 3% and IREN down around 2%.
Shares in Rocket Lab tumbled over 9%, having lost about 8% on Wednesday, after it announced it was postponing the maiden launch of its Neutron rocket again.
Micron Technology fell more than 3% amid a broader selloff in chipmakers, led by South Korea's Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, which were both down between 9% and 11%. Intel shed 3%, while Marvell Technology and Advanced Micro Devices slipped by around 2.5%.
